purpose: 20 representative sequential tasks across the three disposable synthetic repositories, consumed by tests/system against the real gafferd/gaffer-runner/gaffer binaries.

sequencing.detail: Exactly one active attempt at a time, dispatched in id order. Every task's base_commit is its repository's pinned initial commit: M1 has no publication or merge route, accepted results move no branch, and tasks never chain.

base_policy: Each repository is registered from repos/make-repos.sh output with the pinned initial commit below; task base_commit equals that commit.
harness_note: All 20 tasks run the fake harness by default (a real child job through the isolation launcher, per the harness contract). Tasks whose harness array also names opencode carry the same brief for the live OpenCode path; the fake path remains the default proof.
fake_spec_note: fake_spec.attempts is the ordered attempt script: attempt N uses attempts[N-1]. edits describe the deterministic edit set - applied by modes that apply edits, declared-but-never-applied by crash/hang/approval (intent only). edit entries carry content (full new file contents), content_base64 (binary), or delete:true. modes create_empty uses content:"".

outcome_semantics.succeeded: Attempt finalized succeeded, trusted checks passed, local acceptance recorded.
outcome_semantics.failed_verification: Artifact failed the repository's trusted checks; the operator then rejects locally.
outcome_semantics.rejected: No acceptable artifact existed (for example a failed manifest); the operator rejects without a verification pass.
outcome_semantics.stopped: Operator stop mid-run; attempt cancelled and reservation released; no retry within this run.
outcome_semantics.retry_then_succeeded: First attempt failed (crash), released, then a retry within budget succeeded.
outcome_semantics.approval_blocked: Harness requested an approval that was never granted; the attempt failed and the task is blocked pending an operator decision.
